defects.description: Grammatically incorrect heading; should be 'Дисковые квоты'.
Glossary term 'disk quota' (дисковая квота) replaced by a different construction 'Квоты на диск'.
Glossary term 'disk quota' (дисковая квота) replaced by 'квот дискового пространства', which is the translation for 'disk space'.
Mixed English and Russian within a single reference/link.
Incorrect grammatical case for 'конфигурация' (should be genitive 'конфигурации') and unnecessary bolding.
